rule: Simplify the words, not the intelligence (Madhav, 2026-10-05). Jarvis reasons with the technical terms; when it speaks, the plain name comes first the first time a term appears in a conversation ('the 50-day average price, the EMA50'), then either. 'ours' is OUR exact setting: never describe a term differently from how Ananta uses it. Terms with used=false are explained when asked, never implied to be part of Ananta.

terms.plain: Bitcoin's average price over the last 50 days
terms.meaning: When Bitcoin closes above it, the market is allowed (we may buy); below it, risk-off (no new long trades).
terms.ours: 50-day exponential average of Bitcoin's daily closes (recent days weigh more)
terms.say: Bitcoin is above its 50-day average price, so the market gate is open.

terms.plain: the coin's average price over the last 20 days
terms.meaning: The short-term trend: price above it means the recent trend is up.
terms.ours: daily closes over 20 days; the trend portfolio holds a coin only while it closes above its 20- and 50-day averages
terms.say: Price is holding above its 20-day average, so the short-term trend supports it.

terms.plain: the coin's average price over the last 50 days
terms.meaning: The medium-term trend; together with the 20-day it tells whether the trend is aligned.
terms.ours: daily closes over 50 days
terms.say: The 20-day average is above the 50-day: the recent trend is stronger than the longer one, which supports the trade.

terms.plain: the coin's average price over the last 200 days
terms.meaning: The long-term trend; a well-watched line where buyers often step in.
terms.ours: simple average of 200 daily closes; also one of our zone kinds
terms.say: It is still above its 200-day average, so the long-term trend is on its side.

terms.plain: momentum: how hard price has been pushed one way
terms.meaning: Under 30 means pushed down hard (stretched); over 70 pushed up hard.
terms.ours: deep-dip setup E6: 15-minute RSI under 30; short dip trade H07: daily 10-day RSI under 30 while above the 200-day, out when back over 40
terms.say: Momentum is stretched to the downside: the kind of dip the short dip trade buys.

terms.plain: how much the price typically moves in a day
terms.meaning: Used to size stops and to compare moves fairly between calm and wild coins.
terms.ours: 14-day average of the daily range; the 4-hour range spaces stacked Explorer trades
terms.say: Solana moves about 4% on a normal day, so the stop sits one normal day away.

terms.plain: a price band where buyers (support) or sellers (resistance) stepped in before
terms.meaning: A band, not a line. Entering a zone is a reason to look, not to trade.
terms.ours: swing zones, the 200-day average and overlapping zones; reviews #6 and #16: new swing zones and the 200-day hold more often than random bands
terms.say: Buyers defended this band twice before; we're inside it now.

terms.plain: how far price can rise before the next sellers' band
terms.meaning: Too little room means costs eat the trade.
terms.ours: trade types need room: short-term 3%+, intraday 1.2-3%; dip trades 1.2%+ since Oct 5 (TK2)
terms.say: There's only half a percent of room before sellers, so no trade.

terms.plain: the price where the idea is proven wrong, so we get out
terms.meaning: Placed where the idea breaks, not at a round number; size comes from its distance.
terms.ours: every paper trade has one; structural stops beat tight ones (review #18)
terms.say: If it closes under this band, the idea is wrong and we're out.

terms.plain: a stop that follows the price up but never down
terms.meaning: Locks in part of a gain while letting the trade run.
terms.ours: Jarvis's trades may trail by a number of daily ranges; every move is logged
terms.say: The stop has moved up with the price, so this trade can no longer lose much.

terms.plain: price pushing through a level it could not pass before
terms.meaning: Works best after a quiet period; many breakouts fail.
terms.ours: E2 breakout after a quiet period; volume breakouts (B3) failed in review #21
terms.say: Price just pushed through the top of its quiet range.

terms.plain: a short drop inside a rising trend
terms.meaning: Buying it means buying the trend at a better price.
terms.ours: E1 pullback in an uptrend
terms.say: This is a small dip inside an uptrend.

terms.plain: the price range getting unusually narrow, often before a bigger move
terms.meaning: Says a move may come, not which way.
terms.ours: E5 squeeze breakout; Squeeze in the hourly watch
terms.say: Bitcoin's range has been unusually tight for half a day.

terms.plain: a sharp sell-off where many give up at once
terms.meaning: Can mark a low, but history did not back buying it on its own (review #5).
terms.ours: your setup M1, capitulation at the lows
terms.say: That looked like a give-up sell-off at the lows.

terms.plain: a dip that stops above the last dip
terms.meaning: A first sign sellers are weakening.
terms.ours: your setup M2, higher-low retest
terms.say: This dip stopped above the last one.

terms.plain: how much trading is happening
terms.meaning: Moves on high volume are taken more seriously; volume describes a day, it is not a reason by itself (review #7).
terms.ours: volume ratio against the recent average
terms.say: Trading activity is about twice its normal level.

terms.plain: the worst fall from a high before recovering
terms.meaning: How much pain a strategy put you through.
terms.ours: reported for every book and review
terms.say: The worst fall so far was 6%.

terms.plain: yearly return divided by the worst fall
terms.meaning: Return per unit of pain; higher is better.
terms.ours: the trend portfolio's pass rule compares it with buy-and-hold
terms.say: It earned more for every bit of drop it suffered.

terms.plain: how sure we are a result is not luck
terms.meaning: Above about 2.5 means luck is an unlikely explanation.
terms.ours: the repair shop's bar is 2.5 in the discovery period
terms.say: It passed, and it's unlikely to be luck.

terms.plain: one market move, however many coins moved in it
terms.meaning: Our coins move together, so trades closing the same day count once as evidence.
terms.ours: no verdict on any watch before 10 independent events
terms.say: Five trades, but one market move, so one piece of evidence.

terms.plain: the same trade placed at a random moment or on a random coin
terms.meaning: The bar every idea must beat after costs.
terms.ours: Explorer random entries; each Jarvis trade has a twin on another coin with the same plan
terms.say: My trades are behind their random twins so far.

terms.plain: a trade we did not take but track anyway
terms.meaning: Shows what a limit or rule cost us.
terms.ours: REJECTED_SLOT (a limit), NO_TYPE (no room), MISSED_CHASE (an order that never filled), RANDOM
terms.say: The trades that limit stopped lost more than the ones we took.

terms.plain: bringing each holding back to its share of the book
terms.meaning: T3-B only re-sizes a coin far from its share, to save costs.
terms.ours: only outside 0.5x-1.5x of its share (review #20)
terms.say: Only Solana drifted far enough to be trimmed back.

terms.plain: what each trade pays the exchange plus the gap between buy and sell prices
terms.meaning: Small trades die from costs; most short-term ideas we tested lost only because of them.
terms.ours: NDAX 0.20% a side plus the measured spread (0.40% assumed for coins outside the lab 10)
terms.say: It made money before costs but not after.

terms.plain: what leveraged buyers pay sellers to keep their bets open
terms.meaning: High funding means the market is crowded with leveraged buyers.
terms.ours: context only: as a filter it failed (review #19)
terms.say: Leveraged buyers are paying a lot right now: it's crowded.

terms.plain: how many leveraged bets are open
terms.meaning: A sharp fall means leverage was flushed out.
terms.ours: context only (review #19)
terms.say: A lot of leveraged bets were closed in the last few days.

terms.plain: the share of trading done by eager buyers
terms.meaning: High means buyers are pushing.
terms.ours: context only: it helped 2024-26 but hurt before (review #19)
terms.say: Eager buyers are doing more of the trading than usual.

terms.plain: how a coin is doing compared with Bitcoin
terms.meaning: Leaders tend to keep leading for a while, but as a filter it hurt the trend book (review #17).
terms.ours: shown, not used to decide
terms.say: Ethereum has done better than Bitcoin this month.

terms.plain: the gap between a fast and a slow average, used as a trend and momentum signal
terms.meaning: Common in charting tools.
terms.ours: not used by Ananta
terms.say: Ananta doesn't use MACD; we read trend from the 20, 50 and 200-day averages.

terms.plain: the average price weighted by how much traded at each price
terms.meaning: Popular with day traders.
terms.ours: not used by Ananta
terms.say: We don't use VWAP; our day-scale tools are the 15-minute setups.

names.P02: Moves that go together count as one bet

names_rule: Display names for internal codes. The app and every API answer show these, never the codes (plan 2.3, tests/test_plain_words.py).
